title: Drake Sounds Off-On Supreme Court Overturning Roe v. Wade, “Man Who Never Got P**** In School Making Laws About What Women Can Do"
htmlContent:
In a 5-4 judgment earlier this year, the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, which established the constitutional right to abortion in the United States in 1973, according to CNBC.

The controversial yet awaited court ruling gives individual states the power to establish their own abortion laws without worrying about running away from Roe, who allowed abortions in the first two trimesters of pregnancy.

Nearly half of the states were expected to ban or severely restrict abortion following the Supreme Court ruling, which is linked to a very restrictive new abortion legislation in Mississippi. The laws will affect tens of millions of people across the country, who may have to cross state borders to receive reproductive health care.

On Friday morning at 12 midnight, Drake and 21 Savage released their project and on the single On ‘Spin Bout U' takes aimed at the US Supreme Court for overturning Roe v. Wade.

“Damn, just turned on the news and seen that men who never got pussy in school
Are makin’ laws about what women can do I gotta protect ya, I’m a made man, tied in, all the way, baby So I gotta respect ya,” Drake said.

After hearing the verse Senior Front Page Editor Huff Post, Philip Lewis tweeted out that he didn't see it coming.

"Wasn’t expecting Drake to take a stance on the overturning of Roe v. Wade on this album."

After sitting in on a listening party on Clubhouse in [The Meez-O-Estates] hosted by Mikey Jets and Meezy who is 21 Savage's manager some listers said no skip tracks on this project, some called it the album of the year.
